title: Stop reading page views.
summary: Metricool: scheduled Thu 15 Oct 13:00 IG + TikTok (8 slides: 1333-posthog-session-replay)
body: Metricool: scheduled Thu 15 Oct 13:00 IG + TikTok (8 slides: 1333-posthog-session-replay)
guide: Watch real visitors use your site with session replay, so you can see where they get stuck instead of guessing from page-view counts. You need a live website, a free PostHog account, and ChatGPT (Codex) or Claude Code to add the snippet.
1. Create a free account at PostHog and make a project for your site.
1. Copy the project's snippet or API key from PostHog's setup page.
1. Ask ChatGPT (Codex) or Claude Code to add the PostHog JavaScript snippet to your site's shared layout, so it loads on every page.
1. Switch on session recordings in PostHog's project settings.
1. Deploy the change, for example on Vercel, then browse your own site once to confirm a recording appears.
1. Open Session replay in PostHog and watch a few recordings of real visitors, noting where they hesitate, click repeatedly or leave.
1. Fix the one place people get stuck, then watch new recordings to check it worked.
Watch out: Session replay records what visitors type, so mask password, payment and personal fields using PostHog's privacy settings before you publish.

```
You are helping me add PostHog session replay to my website. My site is <describe site, e.g. a Next.js app> and I deploy it with <hosting, e.g. Vercel>. I have a PostHog account and my project API key is <PROJECT_API_KEY>, stored as an environment variable rather than written into the code.
Please:
1. Install and initialise the PostHog JavaScript library in the shared layout so it runs on every page.
2. Enable session recording.
3. Mask all input fields by default, and block recording on these pages or elements: <list pages or fields with personal or payment data>.
4. Keep the API key in an environment variable and show me where to set it in <hosting>.
Return the exact code changes file by file, the settings I need to switch on in the PostHog dashboard, and a short checklist to confirm that a recording appears after I deploy. Do not add any tracking beyond page views and session recording.
```
